item.title: Haitian adoptee with disabilities returns to U.S., seeks ‘freedom’ after years of ordeal
item.description: Joie, a 21-year-old woman with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD), returned to the U.S. in late February after being sent to Haiti against her will. After returning to the U.S., she wants freedom following years of abuse and isolation in a Jamaican boarding school and at the home of an American family.

item.title: ICE in Alabama yank Haitian father from minivan as kids watch, traumatizing family
item.description: A Haitian TPS holder in Alabama detained by immigration authorities is feeling “torture” as his wife and children grapple with his absence and legal questions.

item.title: Kenya-led mission leaves Haiti, as new Gang Suppression Force arrives
item.description: Kenyan police have begun withdrawing from Haiti as the MSS security mission transitions to the newest UN-backed force to stabilize the country, amid ongoing gang violence and criticism that Haiti was excluded from key security talks.

item.title: Promises of fast cash pull Haitians into JBS, harsh conditions push them out — and to strike
item.description: Haitian immigrants are attracted to Colorado meatpacking jobs by promises of quick and good money, but many encounter tough conditions, high injury dangers and alleged exploitation, fueling a cycle of recruitment, burnout, lawsuits and labor unrest.

item.title: IBC plane skids off flooded runway in Les Cayes, Haiti, narrowly averting marketplace
item.description: An IBC Airways plane skidded off the runway Friday while landing at Antoine Simon International Airport in Les Cayes, Haiti. The aircraft, carrying 10 passengers on a flight from Miami to the southern Haitian city, had braking issues on the flooded runway, officials said. No injuries were reported.

item.title: Haiti eliminated from U-17 women’s World Cup qualifiers as visa issues sideline key players
item.description: Haiti’s under-17 women’s team was eliminated from the World Cup qualifiers after falling to Puerto Rico 3-1 and the U.S. 9-0. Haiti played without five key players due to visa issues, including two star midfielders, the starting goalkeeper and the anchor of the defense, who is also the captain.

item.title: Haiti PM Fils-Aimé names ex-ministers to key posts, fueling criticism over priorities
item.description: Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé appointed some of his former ministers and new officials to ambassadorial and agency roles after a March 20 Cabinet meeting. Critics say the reshuffle reflects political elites' power-sharing and a desire to maintain grip on the country’s meager resources rather than prioritizing security and credible elections amid Haiti’s deepening crisis.

item.title: Air Canada plane collides with fire truck at LaGuardia, killing two and injuring dozens
item.description: An Air Canada jet hit a fire truck at LaGuardia Airport in Queens, New York late Sunday night, killing two pilots and injuring dozens in a runway collision.

item.title: ICE officers go to TSA checkpoints at Trump’s direction, while long wait times at airports persist
item.description: ICE officers deployed at U.S. airports as TSA shortages during shutdown cause long wait times and safety concerns.

item.title: Dozens in Haiti rely on savings groups to access credit where bank loans are unavailable
item.description: In Port-au-Prince, AVÈK savings groups provide members with small loans from collective funds to support businesses and income-generating activities, offering an alternative to banks.

item.title: Residents of Haiti’s Northwest demand completion of airport 20 years in the making
item.description: Residents of Port-de-Paix continue to demand an action plan rather than just words from government officials regarding the construction of an international airport in the region. The National Airport Authority (AAN) announced that a plan is in place to move forward with the project. However, as of Monday, no detailed plan, budget or timeline has been made public.
